parameterization.component_tree: Keep each selected native component and its children together; resize through its group coordinate system.
parameterization.repetition: Solve positions from available region, component extents and gaps. Observed instance count is evidence, not permission to add/remove items.
parameterization.text: Bind complete user text to reviewed roles; recompute inner boxes and reject failed measurements. Preserve text-bearing geometric shapes.
parameterization.style: Map source colors to explicit theme roles and retain shape/fill/line relationships; preserve native paths via the verified source.
parameterization.semantics: Geometric equality does not imply semantic equivalence. Review relation, reading order and role bindings before admission.
